title: Apple Pay Finally Comes To Walmart Next Week (But There's A Catch) - BGR
summary: Walmart will continue to offer other payment options, like cash, credit card, or Walmart Pay, which, until now, used to be the more "convenient" way to pay with a phone, as customers could see purchases, receipts, and access Walmart+ fuel savings.
